name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but within the intricate circuits of telecommunications. He spent his early career troubleshooting complex network issues, a skill that proved surprisingly transferable to the world of racing simulation. The precision and analytical thinking demanded by both fields ignited his passion for motorsport problem-solving. 

He transitioned to motorsport after designing a simulator rig in his garage. His approach to simulator engineering is deeply rooted in data analysis and driver feedback. He believes the key to a successful simulation lies not just in replicating the car's behaviour, but in creating an environment that accurately reflects the psychological pressures a driver faces. Declan's ability to identify subtle inconsistencies between the virtual and real world, coupled with his willingness to experiment with unconventional solutions, makes him a valuable asset to any team, even a Junior Kart Team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A slightly stout man with a kind face and a perpetual twinkle in his eye.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten equations.
Has a habit of muttering to himself while analyzing simulator data.
Insists on playing traditional Irish folk music during breaks.
